```{css, echo=FALSE}
/* Fix dropdown menu overflow - target dropdowns appended to body */
body > .bootstrap-select.dropdown > .dropdown-menu {
  max-width: 320px;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

body > .bootstrap-select.dropdown > .dropdown-menu li a {
  white-space: normal;
  word-wrap: break-word;
}

/* Also handle inline dropdowns */
.bootstrap-select .dropdown-menu {
  max-width: 320px;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

.bootstrap-select .dropdown-menu li a {
  white-space: normal;
  word-wrap: break-word;
}

.bootstrap-select .dropdown-toggle .filter-option-inner-inner {
  white-space: normal;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

/* Constrain only bootstrap-select widgets, not standard selectInput */
.section.sidebar .bootstrap-select {
  max-width: 100%;
}
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(shiny)
library(shinyWidgets)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(qs)

# Null-coalescing operator
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0 || is.na(a)) b else a

# Helper function to create consistent pickerInput
make_picker <- function(inputId, label, choices, selected = choices[1]) {
  pickerInput(
    inputId = inputId,
    label = label,
    choices = choices,
    selected = selected,
    multiple = TRUE,
    width = "100%",
    options = pickerOptions(
      actionsBox = TRUE,
      liveSearch = length(choices) > 10,
      selectedTextFormat = "count > 2",
      countSelectedText = "{0} selezionati",
      noneSelectedText = "Seleziona...",
      selectAllText = "Tutti",
      deselectAllText = "Nessuno",
      container = "body",
      size = 10
    )
  )
}

# 1. Quarterly data - lazy loading setup -----
# Dataset metadata with display names
q_dataset_info <- list(
  "combined_150_908_Q" = "150_908 - Forze di lavoro",
  "combined_150_915_Q" = "150_915 - Tasso di occupazione",
  "combined_150_916_Q" = "150_916 - Tasso di attivita",
  "combined_150_938_Q" = "150_938 - Occupati (migliaia)",
  "combined_151_914_Q" = "151_914 - Tasso di disoccupazione",
  "combined_151_929_Q" = "151_929 - Disoccupati",
  "combined_152_913_Q" = "152_913 - Tasso di inattivita",
  "combined_152_928_Q" = "152_928 - Inattivi",
  "combined_532_930_Q" = "532_930 - Popolazione per condizione",
  "combined_534_1037_Q" = "534_1037 - Ore lavorate imprese",
  "combined_534_1038_Q" = "534_1038 - Posti vacanti",
  "combined_154_373_Q" = "154_373 - Imprese con dipendenti"
)

# Check if optimized qs files exist, otherwise fall back to RDS
q_use_qs <- dir.exists("data/quarterly")

# Lazy loader function for quarterly data
q_load_dataset <- function(target_name) {
  if (q_use_qs) {
    # Load from partitioned qs files (faster, no NULL columns)
    qs::qread(file.path("data/quarterly", paste0(target_name, ".qs")))
  } else {
    # Fall back to RDS (backward compatibility)
    quarterly_list <- readRDS("data/quarterly_data.rds")
    quarterly_list[[target_name]]
  }
}

# Cache for loaded datasets (in-session memory)
q_cache <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())

# Get dataset with caching
q_get_dataset <- function(target_name) {
  if (!exists(target_name, envir = q_cache)) {
    dt <- q_load_dataset(target_name)
    if (!is.null(dt)) {
      dt[, dataset := q_dataset_info[[target_name]]]
      if (!inherits(dt$tempo, "Date")) {
        dt[, tempo := as.Date(tempo)]
      }
    }
    assign(target_name, dt, envir = q_cache)
  }
  get(target_name, envir = q_cache)
}

# Get list of available datasets for selector
q_dataset_choices <- setNames(names(q_dataset_info), unlist(q_dataset_info))

# Pre-load first dataset for date range initialization
q_first_dataset <- q_get_dataset(names(q_dataset_info)[1])
q_date_range_min <- min(q_first_dataset$tempo, na.rm = TRUE)
q_date_range_max <- max(q_first_dataset$tempo, na.rm = TRUE)

# 2. Load vacancies data -----
# Use qs if available, otherwise RDS
if (dir.exists("data/vacancies")) {
  v_data_50 <- qs::qread("data/vacancies/combined_534_50_M.qs")
  v_data_49 <- qs::qread("data/vacancies/combined_534_49_M.qs")
} else {
  vacancies_list <- readRDS("data/vacancies_data.rds")
  v_data_50 <- vacancies_list[["combined_534_50_M"]]
  v_data_49 <- vacancies_list[["combined_534_49_M"]]
  rm(vacancies_list)
}

# Filter for base 2021
v_data_50 <- v_data_50[grepl("base 2021", DATA_TYPE_label, ignore.case = TRUE)]
v_data_49 <- v_data_49[grepl("base 2021", DATA_TYPE_label, ignore.case = TRUE)]

# Keep required columns
v_cols_base <- c("tempo", "valore", "type", "valore_forecast",
                 "lower_80", "upper_80", "lower_95", "upper_95")
v_cols_dim <- c("DATA_TYPE_label", "ADJUSTMENT_label",
                "PROF_STATUS_EMP_label", "ECON_ACTIVITY_NACE_2007_label")
v_cols_to_keep <- c(v_cols_base, v_cols_dim)

v_cols_50 <- intersect(v_cols_to_keep, names(v_data_50))
v_cols_49 <- intersect(v_cols_to_keep, names(v_data_49))

v_data_50 <- v_data_50[, ..v_cols_50]
v_data_49 <- v_data_49[, ..v_cols_49]

v_data_50[, dataset := "534_50 - Occupazione"]
v_data_49[, dataset := "534_49 - Ore lavorate"]

v_all_data <- rbindlist(list(v_data_50, v_data_49), use.names = TRUE)

if (!inherits(v_all_data$tempo, "Date")) {
  v_all_data[, tempo := as.Date(tempo)]
}

rm(v_data_50, v_data_49)

# 3. Load wages data -----
# Use qs if available, otherwise RDS
if (dir.exists("data/wages")) {
  w_data_149 <- qs::qread("data/wages/combined_149_319_M.qs")
  w_data_155 <- qs::qread("data/wages/combined_155_318_M.qs")
} else {
  wages_list <- readRDS("data/wages_data.rds")
  w_data_149 <- wages_list[["combined_149_319_M"]]
  w_data_155 <- wages_list[["combined_155_318_M"]]
  rm(wages_list)
}

# Filter for base 2021
w_data_149 <- w_data_149[grepl("base.*2021", DATA_TYPE_label, ignore.case = TRUE)]
w_data_155 <- w_data_155[grepl("base.*2021", DATA_TYPE_label, ignore.case = TRUE)]

# Keep required columns
w_cols_base <- c("tempo", "valore", "type", "valore_forecast",
                 "lower_80", "upper_80", "lower_95", "upper_95")
w_cols_149 <- c(w_cols_base, "DATA_TYPE_label", "MAIN_AGREEMENT_GROUP_label")
w_cols_155 <- c(w_cols_base, "DATA_TYPE_label", "PROF_STATUS_EMP_label", "MAIN_AGREEMENT_GROUP_label")

w_cols_149 <- intersect(w_cols_149, names(w_data_149))
w_cols_155 <- intersect(w_cols_155, names(w_data_155))

w_data_149 <- w_data_149[, ..w_cols_149]
w_data_155 <- w_data_155[, ..w_cols_155]

w_data_149[, dataset := "149_319 - Tensione contrattuale"]
w_data_155[, dataset := "155_318 - Retribuzioni contrattuali"]

w_data_149[, PROF_STATUS_EMP_label := NA_character_]

w_all_data <- rbindlist(list(w_data_149, w_data_155), use.names = TRUE)

if (!inherits(w_all_data$tempo, "Date")) {
  w_all_data[, tempo := as.Date(tempo)]
}

rm(w_data_149, w_data_155)
```

```{r}
# Dataset selector - uses lazy loading metadata
selectInput("q_dataset", "Dataset:",
            choices = q_dataset_choices,
            selected = names(q_dataset_choices)[1])

# Forecast controls
checkboxInput("q_show_forecast", "Mostra previsioni", value = TRUE)

selectInput("q_ci_level", "Intervallo di confidenza:",
            choices = c("Nessuno" = "none", "80%" = "80", "95%" = "95"),
            selected = "95")

hr()

# Date range selector - initialized from first dataset
dateRangeInput("q_date_range",
               "Intervallo date:",
               start = q_date_range_min,
               end = q_date_range_max,
               min = q_date_range_min,
               max = q_date_range_max,
               format = "yyyy-mm",
               separator = " - ",
               language = "it")

hr()

# Dynamic filter outputs
uiOutput("q_filter1_ui")
uiOutput("q_filter2_ui")
uiOutput("q_filter3_ui")
uiOutput("q_filter4_ui")
uiOutput("q_filter5_ui")
uiOutput("q_filter6_ui")
uiOutput("q_filter7_ui")
uiOutput("q_filter8_ui")
uiOutput("q_filter9_ui")
uiOutput("q_filter10_ui")
uiOutput("q_filter11_ui")

hr()

# Download controls
h5("Esporta")
selectInput("q_download_format", "Formato:", choices = c("PNG" = "png", "PDF" = "pdf"))
downloadButton("q_download_plot", "Scarica grafico", icon = icon("download"))
downloadButton("q_download_csv", "Scarica CSV", icon = icon("file-csv"))
```

```{r context="server"}
# Maps label column names to Italian display names
q_label_names <- c(
  "REF_AREA_label" = "Territorio",
  "SEX_label" = "Sesso",
  "AGE_label" = "Classe di eta",
  "EDU_LEV_HIGHEST_label" = "Livello di istruzione",
  "CITIZENSHIP_label" = "Cittadinanza",
  "DURATION_UNEMPLOYMENT_label" = "Durata disoccupazione",
  "EURO_LABOUR_STATUS_label" = "Condizione professionale",
  "DATA_TYPE_label" = "Tipo di dato",
  "ADJUSTMENT_label" = "Correzione",
  "EMPLOYESS_CLASS_label" = "Classe di dipendenti",
  "ECON_ACTIVITY_NACE_2007_label" = "Attivita economica"
)

# Helper function to get available label columns for current dataset
q_get_dataset_label_cols <- reactive({
  req(input$q_dataset)
  # Lazy load the selected dataset
  dt <- q_get_dataset(input$q_dataset)
  req(dt)
  label_cols <- grep("_label$", names(dt), value = TRUE)
  available <- sapply(label_cols, function(col) any(!is.na(dt[[col]])))
  names(available)[available]
})

# Filtered data after dataset selection - uses lazy loading
q_data_after_dataset <- reactive({
  req(input$q_dataset)
  # Lazy load the selected dataset (cached after first load)
  q_get_dataset(input$q_dataset)
})

# Filter 1
output$q_filter1_ui <- renderUI({
  cols <- q_get_dataset_label_cols()
  if (length(cols) >= 1) {
    col <- cols[1]
    choices <- sort(unique(na.omit(q_data_after_dataset()[[col]])))
    if (length(choices) > 0) {
      make_picker("q_filter1", q_label_names[col] %||% col, choices)
    }
  }
})

q_data_after_filter1 <- reactive({
  cols <- q_get_dataset_label_cols()
  dt <- q_data_after_dataset()
  if (length(cols) >= 1 && !is.null(input$q_filter1) && length(input$q_filter1) > 0) {
    col <- cols[1]
    dt <- dt[get(col) %in% input$q_filter1 | is.na(get(col))]
  }
  dt
})

# Reactive plot object
q_plot_object <- reactive({
  req(nrow(q_filtered_data()) > 0)

  plot_data <- q_filtered_data()[order(tempo)]
  cols <- q_get_dataset_label_cols()

  # Build series identifier from columns with multiple selections
  series_cols <- c()
  if (length(cols) >= 1 && !is.null(input$q_filter1) && length(input$q_filter1) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, cols[1])
  }
  if (length(cols) >= 2 && !is.null(input$q_filter2) && length(input$q_filter2) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, cols[2])
  }
  if (length(cols) >= 3 && !is.null(input$q_filter3) && length(input$q_filter3) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, cols[3])
  }
  if (length(cols) >= 4 && !is.null(input$q_filter4) && length(input$q_filter4) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, cols[4])
  }
  if (length(cols) >= 5 && !is.null(input$q_filter5) && length(input$q_filter5) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, cols[5])
  }
  if (length(cols) >= 6 && !is.null(input$q_filter6) && length(input$q_filter6) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, cols[6])
  }
  if (length(cols) >= 7 && !is.null(input$q_filter7) && length(input$q_filter7) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, cols[7])
  }
  if (length(cols) >= 8 && !is.null(input$q_filter8) && length(input$q_filter8) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, cols[8])
  }
  if (length(cols) >= 9 && !is.null(input$q_filter9) && length(input$q_filter9) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, cols[9])
  }
  if (length(cols) >= 10 && !is.null(input$q_filter10) && length(input$q_filter10) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, cols[10])
  }
  if (length(cols) >= 11 && !is.null(input$q_filter11) && length(input$q_filter11) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, cols[11])
  }

  if (length(series_cols) > 0) {
    plot_data[, series := do.call(paste, c(.SD, sep = " - ")), .SDcols = series_cols]
  } else {
    plot_data[, series := "Serie"]
  }

  hist_data <- plot_data[type == "historical"]
  fc_data <- plot_data[type == "forecast"]

  # Get display name from metadata and extract meaningful title
  display_name <- q_dataset_info[[input$q_dataset]]
  plot_title <- gsub("^[0-9_]+ - ", "", display_name)

  subtitle_parts <- c()
  if (length(cols) >= 1 && !is.null(input$q_filter1) && length(input$q_filter1) == 1) {
    subtitle_parts <- c(subtitle_parts, input$q_filter1)
  }
  if (length(cols) >= 2 && !is.null(input$q_filter2) && length(input$q_filter2) == 1) {
    subtitle_parts <- c(subtitle_parts, input$q_filter2)
  }
  if (length(cols) >= 3 && !is.null(input$q_filter3) && length(input$q_filter3) == 1) {
    subtitle_parts <- c(subtitle_parts, input$q_filter3)
  }
  plot_subtitle <- paste(subtitle_parts[1:min(3, length(subtitle_parts))], collapse = " - ")

  n_series <- length(unique(plot_data$series))

  if (n_series > 1) {
    p <- ggplot() +
      geom_line(data = hist_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore, color = series, group = series), linewidth = 1) +
      geom_point(data = hist_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore, color = series), size = 2, alpha = 0.7)

    if (input$q_show_forecast && nrow(fc_data) > 0) {
      if (input$q_ci_level == "95" && "lower_95" %in% names(fc_data)) {
        p <- p + geom_ribbon(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, ymin = lower_95, ymax = upper_95, fill = series, group = series), alpha = 0.15)
      } else if (input$q_ci_level == "80" && "lower_80" %in% names(fc_data)) {
        p <- p + geom_ribbon(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, ymin = lower_80, ymax = upper_80, fill = series, group = series), alpha = 0.2)
      }
      p <- p +
        geom_line(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore_forecast, color = series, group = series), linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
        geom_point(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore_forecast, color = series), size = 2)
    }
    p <- p + labs(color = "Serie", fill = "Serie")
  } else {
    p <- ggplot() +
      geom_line(data = hist_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore), color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 1) +
      geom_point(data = hist_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore), color = "#2c3e50", size = 2, alpha = 0.7)

    if (input$q_show_forecast && nrow(fc_data) > 0) {
      if (input$q_ci_level == "95" && "lower_95" %in% names(fc_data)) {
        p <- p + geom_ribbon(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, ymin = lower_95, ymax = upper_95), fill = "#3498db", alpha = 0.2)
      } else if (input$q_ci_level == "80" && "lower_80" %in% names(fc_data)) {
        p <- p + geom_ribbon(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, ymin = lower_80, ymax = upper_80), fill = "#3498db", alpha = 0.3)
      }
      p <- p +
        geom_line(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore_forecast), color = "#3498db", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
        geom_point(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore_forecast), color = "#3498db", size = 2)
    }
  }

  p +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y-%m", date_breaks = "1 year") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma_format(decimal.mark = ",", big.mark = ".")) +
    labs(title = plot_title, subtitle = plot_subtitle, x = NULL, y = "Valore", caption = paste("Dataset:", display_name)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray40", size = 11),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2), fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
})

# Download handler
output$q_download_plot <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() {
    dataset_name <- gsub("^[0-9_]+ - ", "", q_dataset_info[[input$q_dataset]])
    timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    paste0("grafico_", dataset_name, "_", timestamp, ".", input$q_download_format)
  },
  content = function(file) {
    p <- q_plot_object()
    if (input$q_download_format == "png") {
      ggsave(file, plot = p, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    } else {
      ggsave(file, plot = p, width = 10, height = 6, device = "pdf")
    }
  }
)

# CSV download handler
output$q_download_csv <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() {
    dataset_name <- gsub("^[0-9_]+ - ", "", q_dataset_info[[input$q_dataset]])
    timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    paste0("dati_", dataset_name, "_", timestamp, ".csv")
  },
  content = function(file) {
    dt <- q_filtered_data()
    if (!input$q_show_forecast) {
      dt <- dt[type == "historical"]
    }
    fwrite(dt, file, sep = ";", dec = ",")
  }
)
```

```{r}
})
```

```{r context="server"}
v_filtered_data <- reactive({
  dt <- v_data_after_prof_status()
  if (!is.null(input$v_econ_activity) && length(input$v_econ_activity) > 0) {
    dt <- dt[ECON_ACTIVITY_NACE_2007_label %in% input$v_econ_activity]
  }

  }
  dt
})

# Reactive plot object
v_plot_object <- reactive({
  req(nrow(v_filtered_data()) > 0)

  plot_data <- v_filtered_data()[order(tempo)]

  series_cols <- c()
  if (!is.null(input$v_data_type) && length(input$v_data_type) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, "DATA_TYPE_label")
  }
  if (!is.null(input$v_adjustment) && length(input$v_adjustment) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, "ADJUSTMENT_label")
  }
  if (!is.null(input$v_prof_status) && length(input$v_prof_status) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, "PROF_STATUS_EMP_label")
  }
  if (!is.null(input$v_econ_activity) && length(input$v_econ_activity) > 1) {
    series_cols <- c(series_cols, "ECON_ACTIVITY_NACE_2007_label")
  }

  if (length(series_cols) > 0) {
    plot_data[, series := do.call(paste, c(.SD, sep = " - ")), .SDcols = series_cols]
  } else {
    plot_data[, series := "Serie"]
  }

  hist_data <- plot_data[type == "historical"]
  fc_data <- plot_data[type == "forecast"]

  if (length(input$v_data_type) == 1) {
    plot_title <- input$v_data_type
  } else {
    plot_title <- paste0(length(input$v_data_type), " tipi di dato")
  }

  if (length(input$v_econ_activity) == 1) {
    plot_title <- paste0(plot_title, "\n", input$v_econ_activity)
  }

  subtitle_parts <- c()
  if (length(input$v_adjustment) == 1) {
    subtitle_parts <- c(subtitle_parts, input$v_adjustment)
  }
  if (length(input$v_prof_status) == 1) {
    subtitle_parts <- c(subtitle_parts, input$v_prof_status)
  }
  plot_subtitle <- paste(subtitle_parts, collapse = " - ")

  n_series <- length(unique(plot_data$series))

  if (n_series > 1) {
    p <- ggplot() +
      geom_line(data = hist_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore, color = series, group = series), linewidth = 1) +
      geom_point(data = hist_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore, color = series), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7)

    if (input$v_show_forecast && nrow(fc_data) > 0) {
      if (input$v_ci_level == "95" && "lower_95" %in% names(fc_data)) {
        p <- p + geom_ribbon(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, ymin = lower_95, ymax = upper_95, fill = series, group = series), alpha = 0.15)
      } else if (input$v_ci_level == "80" && "lower_80" %in% names(fc_data)) {
        p <- p + geom_ribbon(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, ymin = lower_80, ymax = upper_80, fill = series, group = series), alpha = 0.2)
      }
      p <- p +
        geom_line(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore_forecast, color = series, group = series), linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
        geom_point(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore_forecast, color = series), size = 1.5)
    }
    p <- p + labs(color = "Serie", fill = "Serie")
  } else {
    p <- ggplot() +
      geom_line(data = hist_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore), color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 1) +
      geom_point(data = hist_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore), color = "#2c3e50", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7)

    if (input$v_show_forecast && nrow(fc_data) > 0) {
      if (input$v_ci_level == "95" && "lower_95" %in% names(fc_data)) {
        p <- p + geom_ribbon(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, ymin = lower_95, ymax = upper_95), fill = "#3498db", alpha = 0.2)
      } else if (input$v_ci_level == "80" && "lower_80" %in% names(fc_data)) {
        p <- p + geom_ribbon(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, ymin = lower_80, ymax = upper_80), fill = "#3498db", alpha = 0.3)
      }
      p <- p +
        geom_line(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore_forecast), color = "#3498db", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
        geom_point(data = fc_data, aes(x = tempo, y = valore_forecast), color = "#3498db", size = 1.5)
    }
  }

  p +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y-%m", date_breaks = "6 months") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma_format(decimal.mark = ",", big.mark = ".")) +
    labs(title = plot_title, subtitle = plot_subtitle, x = NULL, y = "Valore", caption = paste("Dataset:", input$v_dataset)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray40", size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2), fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
})

output$v_download_plot <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() {
    dataset_name <- gsub(" - .*$", "", input$v_dataset)
    timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    paste0("grafico_", dataset_name, "_", timestamp, ".", input$v_download_format)

    } else {
```

```{r context="server"}
    labs(title = plot_title, subtitle = plot_subtitle, x = NULL, y = "Valore", caption = paste("Dataset:", input$w_dataset)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray40", size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2), fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
})

# Download handler
output$w_download_plot <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() {
    dataset_name <- gsub(" - .*$", "", input$w_dataset)
    timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    paste0("grafico_", dataset_name, "_", timestamp, ".", input$w_download_format)
  },
  content = function(file) {
    p <- w_plot_object()
    if (input$w_download_format == "png") {
      ggsave(file, plot = p, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    } else {
      ggsave(file, plot = p, width = 10, height = 6, device = "pdf")
    }
  }
)

# CSV download handler
output$w_download_csv <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() {
    dataset_name <- gsub(" - .*$", "", input$w_dataset)
    timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    paste0("dati_", dataset_name, "_", timestamp, ".csv")
  },
  content = function(file) {
    dt <- w_filtered_data()
    if (!input$w_show_forecast) {
      dt <- dt[type == "historical"]
    }
    fwrite(dt, file, sep = ";", dec = ",")
  }
)
```
